text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —I heard that voice while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DERBYYYYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How many times have I been encouraged by 
her cheerful voice as she earnestly looks 
ahead? But—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
On this day, that voice sounded truly 
terrifying.

Near the stands. The spectators welcome 
the victorious 1st-place Biwa Hayahide 
with applause. However, she—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ...*gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Blonde Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Aweeeesome! Biwa Hayahideーー!! She just 
conquered the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! At this rate, the Kikuka Sho 
will be a breeze!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *cough*, *urgh*...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(What are they saying...?! In that race 
just now, I gave it my absolute all and 
still ended up with this.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(At the Kikuka Sho, with an even longer 
distance...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, next time for sure...! I'll push 
even further...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Kh, khhuuuuu~~~~~!!!! Uwooooooooooohhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (To them, I...!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... Thank you.

However, Biwa Hayahide falls silent once 
more. ...Quite somber for someone who just 
conquered the Derby.

What words should I offer her? As I 
searched for the right thing to say—

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Excuse me~~! Winning Tiiicket-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Weekly Winner's Step here!! You'll 
let me interview you today, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course!! Sorry for turning you 
down before!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all! So, how did the Derby 
go?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It was the absolute best! Everyone was 
cheering so loud, going 'Whoaaaa!' It 
really felt like a dream... No, even 
better.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It was even more amazing than a dream!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Though we did lose.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I worked super hard, you know. 
Because I wanted to win no matter what. I 
trained so, so much with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... So you see, Mr. Reporter. I'm 
super frustrated right now, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll win next time, I swear 
it............!
A little while after that—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun, will you listen to me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It seems... I am currently afraid. Afraid 
of those two.

As if squeezing the words out from deep 
within, Biwa Hayahide began to speak, bit 
by bit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
About Taishin from the Satsuki Sho. About 
Ticket from the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I should have run the numbers through so 
many different formulas. Yet neither of 
those two will fit into any of them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is this because my formula remains 
incomplete? Or perhaps... it wasn't an 
oversight at all, but 'something' 
inherently beyond reach—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Pathetic, isn't it...? Even after 
winning the Derby... here I am...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list:
You can admit your weakness, so you can 
become even stronger.

You can admit your weakness, so you can 
become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: Let's figure out what's missing together.

text_block_list.text:
And then, I discussed things with Biwa 
Hayahide in the waiting room for a while.

Why did she fear the two of them? What 
does she think is the difference between 
herself and those two—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to gain the strength they 
possess—something I do not have.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Don't go worrying over nothing. I 
can still run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw Hayahide's race too, didn't you? 
She really was strong. It made me wanna 
win. That's exactly why—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I... tried so, so hard. Because I wanted 
to win no matter what. I trained with all 
my might, so, so much.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“It is the 'will to become strong.' ...A 
resolve unbothered by whatever 
consequences may come.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That is why, Trainer. I have a request for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Regarding what comes next, please do not 
fear. I want you to push me through 
rigorous training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My body will not break. After all, I am no 
longer the child I once was.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I will not be defeated...! I must push 
myself even further...!!"

Even after returning to the academy from 
Tokyo Racecourse, her incredible momentum 
showed no signs of fading.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will never... lose again...!
...Along with an abnormal obsession.

—The next goal, the 'Kikuka Sho', would be 
the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown 
route.
